events.title: Lua 5.0 released
events.summary: The Lua team released Lua 5.0 in April 2003 — a major rewrite with lexical scoping, metamethods, and coroutines.
events.about: Lua 5.0 is the dialect embedded in Redis, World of Warcraft addons, Nginx (OpenResty), and game engines worldwide. Coroutines and metatables let hosts extend the language without bloating the core — the model for embedded scripting today.

narrative.whyChosen: Lua 5.0 is the version every modern embedding target still ships.
narrative.whyImportant: Lexical scoping and coroutines made Lua viable for serious game and server scripting.
narrative.problemSolved: Lua 4's dynamic scoping and limited coroutines restricted complex embedded logic.
